environment.description: Same Spring Boot trading application deployed on EKS with Aurora PostgreSQL 14.6. The database connection pool (HikariCP) is configured to connect as role 'trading_ro_svc' which inherits from the 'readonly_base' role. The PostgreSQL role hierarchy: 'readonly_base' has been granted SELECT on schema 'trading' via column-level grants on non-sensitive columns only. A separate event-driven microservice handles order mutations through an SQS queue. The 'trading_ro_svc' role has explicit REVOKE on INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE for all tables, with a PostgreSQL event trigger (ddl_command_end) that automatically revokes DML on any newly created tables. pg_hba.conf restricts 'trading_ro_svc' to connections from the EKS pod CIDR only (10.0.64.0/18). The application's JDBC URL includes 'readOnly=true&defaultRowFetchSize=100'.

config.db_role_hierarchy: trading_ro_svc -> readonly_base (SELECT only on trading schema)
config.db_grants: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA trading TO readonly_base; REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA trading FROM trading_ro_svc;
config.event_trigger: ddl_command_end trigger auto-revokes DML from readonly_base on new tables
config.mutation_path: Order mutations handled by separate write-service consuming from SQS, not this application
